Source article title: Anne Kepner
Source introduction:
Report an officeholder change
Anne Kepner is a member of the West Valley-Mission Community College District Board of Trustees in California, representing Trustees Area 3. She assumed office in 2014. Her current term ends in 2026.
Kepner is running for re-election to the West Valley-Mission Community College District Board of Trustees to represent Trustees Area 3 in California. She is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Kepner (Democratic Party) also ran for election to the California State Senate to represent District 10. She lost in the primary on June 2, 2026.
